scope.authority_boundary: Course-native sources remain authoritative. The central policy records concept decisions and deterministic change packets; it does not overwrite producer bytes by implication.
scope.methodology_boundary: The cited standards and institutional guidance support concept orientation, harmonization, evidence, register metadata, validation, and interchange. The exact ordering below—including native or naturalized preference as a late tie-breaker—is this program's explicit synthesis, not a claim that ISO, UNESCO, or the European Commission mandates that ranking.

decision_procedure.rule: Establish the mathematical concept and subject field before comparing designations; never merge forms that designate different concepts.
Prefer the designation most broadly understood by the intended Indonesian readership when it preserves the exact concept.
When comprehension is effectively tied, prefer the more precise and less ambiguous field term.
Compare actually attested compounds, definitions, collocations, and concept-system relations; prefer the designation supporting the coherent advanced family.
Prefer continuity from introductory through advanced material unless evidence supports an explicit level or register transition.
Prefer current authoritative Indonesian specialist and nationally established usage over resemblance to the source language.

Only after the preceding criteria tie, prefer an established native or more fully Indonesian-naturalized form; do not force a novel coinage or prefer an internationalism merely for English interoperability.

Resolve one preferred Indonesian designation per concept; retain well-attested alternatives as admitted search aliases and mark misleading or obsolete forms deprecated. Never alternate aliases for style.
Freeze resolved decisions across the applicable corpus. A later change requires cited evidence, an impact list, deterministic propagation, QA, and a versioned change receipt.

designation_policy.preferred: Exactly one production designation per locale and concept after resolution.
designation_policy.admitted: A well-attested alternative retained for search, retrieval, quotations, or an explicitly documented register; not used as stylistic variation.
designation_policy.deprecated: A misleading, obsolete, mathematically inaccurate, or superseded form retained only for detection and migration.
designation_policy.candidate: An unresolved form under evidence review; never production-eligible.
designation_policy.interoperability_rule: English and other-language equivalents attach to the locale-neutral concept ID; they do not decide the Indonesian preferred form.

register_policy.source_level_match: Choose Indonesian wording appropriate to the source level and learner route while preserving the same concept.
register_policy.transition_rule: A different preferred designation at another level is permitted only when it belongs to a distinct concept record or when an explicit register transition is supported by cited Indonesian evidence.
register_policy.continuity_rule: Do not silently switch labels between modules or levels. Introduce an admitted specialist alias once at a documented transition, then use the applicable preferred designation consistently.

termbase_contract.resolved_invariant: A resolved concept is production-eligible and has exactly one preferred designation in each represented locale.
termbase_contract.unresolved_invariant: An evidence-required concept is not production-eligible and must not drive automatic replacement.

current_central_observations.observation: B90 is titled Probabilitas Berbasis Kalkulus while its topic label and outcome use peluang.

The generated B90 record combines the title and purpose root probabilitas, the topic and outcome root peluang, and a course-native edition filename PENGANTAR_PELUANG; this proves usage variation, not terminological preference.

The generated D30 record combines the advanced title Probabilitas Teoretis-Ukuran with the topic and prose root peluang; this suggests a possible register boundary but does not establish current Indonesian national or specialist preference.

probability_family_audit.boundary_rule: Resolve every concept separately. If Indonesian evidence supports peluang for the scalar or introductory concept and probabilitas for particular advanced compounds, encode explicit concept/register boundaries rather than free synonym mixing. If one root is broadly understood and demonstrably dominates the attested advanced family without loss of precision, standardize it across the applicable concepts.
evidence_required_before_resolution: current nationally established Indonesian terminology with exact concept-level citations
current Indonesian specialist sources spanning introductory and advanced probability
attested compound and collocation counts tied to exact source identities
an impact inventory for B90, B95, D30, central navigation, aliases, and machine records
probability_family_audit.present_conclusion: The supplied standards establish the decision method but do not contain Indonesian probability usage evidence. The family therefore remains explicitly unresolved and no root is imposed by intuition.

deterministic_propagation.precondition: Only a resolved, versioned concept record with cited evidence is eligible for propagation.

steps.action: Canonicalize the concept record and record its byte count and SHA-256.
Generate exact course, module, glossary, search-alias, navigation, metadata, and adapter locations; distinguish mathematical senses from lexical matches.
Create a deterministic replacement plan scoped to concept IDs and approved grammatical forms; never run an unscoped text replacement.
Apply through the owning course workflow, preserving native authority and version history.
Replay semantic, formula, link, build, alias, deprecated-form, and terminology-consistency checks.
Rebuild twice, require byte identity where the owner workflow is deterministic, and compare the observed impact set with the frozen plan.
Record source hashes, output hashes, changed locations, residual exceptions, QA results, rollback identity, and the new concept-record version.

deterministic_propagation.failure_rule: Any ambiguous match, mathematical-sense collision, missing owner route, or failed deterministic QA stops only that propagation packet and leaves the prior public terminology unchanged.

change_log.change: Established the concept-oriented Indonesian register policy and recorded the peluang/probabilitas family as evidence-required without changing course-native content.
